about: The LED elements of A River Becoming as Modal Frames sees them. Published by river-bitcube (modal-frames/layout.json); Modal reads it rather than hard-coding sizes. Every image is 8-bit sRGB RGB, row 0 = the top as the element hangs, column 0 = its left as seen from the front.

elements.up: row 0 is the top edge of the screen as hung (portrait)
row 0 is the top edge of the screen as hung (portrait)
row 0 is the top edge of the screen as hung (portrait)
row 0 is the top edge of the screen as hung (portrait)
row 0 is the hanging (top) end of every rope; row 399 is its bottom end
elements.columns: column c is rope c+1 (ropes 1 to 20); one LED per row

river_region_about: [x, y, w, h] in the river video (0-1, origin top-left): the part of the moving river each element takes its ripples from. Chosen by bitcube; published so a Modal preview can imitate the result. Modal never needs to set it.
